description.value: Station House Gallery occupies Williams Lake's oldest building — a Pacific Great Eastern Railway station constructed in 1919 — and has operated as a community arts hub since the Station House Studio & Gallery Society formed in 1981. The non-profit runs two gallery spaces with rotating monthly exhibitions and a gift shop stocked with locally made pottery, jewellery, woodwork, paintings, and artisan food products. Admission is always free, making it an easy and enriching stop for a touring cyclist passing through the Cariboo.
